instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Digital lending platform focusing on B2B/B2C credit solutions, leveraging machine learning for automated underwriting of micro-loans. It operates primarily via licensed APIs to connect with partner banks and utilizes open banking data streams for real-time fraud detection.
answers.pastInitiatives: The engineering team successfully transitioned to a 2-week sprint cadence, improving development velocity by 60%. However, the lack of formalized governance means adjacent departments like marketing and compliance have struggled to integrate these changes fully, leading to inconsistent execution across the board.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is to solidify our position as the trusted incumbent provider for SME working capital financing by enhancing loan portfolio quality and reducing customer attrition. We aim to increase average customer lifetime value (CLV) through superior customer experience while strictly avoiding price wars with newer, heavily capitalized entrants.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently leveraging its established reputation and existing loan book as a primary moat against aggressive new entrants.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Enhance Credit Scoring Model Robustness
opportunities.rationale: Given the conservative risk appetite and high competitive pressure, incrementally improving the accuracy of the credit decisioning engine is crucial to maintaining portfolio quality. This ensures Aether remains a reliable partner in lending.

first_actions: Conduct quarterly A/B testing on the new ML scoring model against legacy systems.
Allocate 10% of the engineering budget specifically for data pipeline refinement.
milestones: Q3: Model validation and performance benchmark.
Q4: Full integration of enhanced scoring into core platform.

opportunities.title: Streamline Internal Process Governance
opportunities.rationale: To overcome the main barrier (process), implementing a lightweight, standardized change management protocol will improve cross-functional alignment and ensure that rapid engineering sprints translate into cohesive product releases.

first_actions: Document and socialize a mandatory 'Innovation Intake' form for all new features.
Establish bi-weekly synchronization meetings between Engineering, Marketing, and Compliance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in feature deployment cycle time by 15%
milestones: Month 3: Full adoption of the new intake process.

opportunities.title: Implement Hyper-Personalized Product Bundling
opportunities.rationale: To defend market share against new entrants, Aether could move beyond simple lending by using the existing data to create highly tailored, subscription-based financial products. This would increase switching costs significantly.

first_actions: Develop a prototype for tiered working capital solutions based on real-time customer spending patterns.
Pilot the bundling strategy with 5% of the SME client base.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in average customer lifetime value (CLV) by 25%
milestones: Q4: Successful pilot of the new bundling structure.

next_steps.action: Formalize and document the 'Innovation Intake' process with required sign-off authority.
Initiate the Q3 A/B testing protocol for the enhanced credit scoring model.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated innovation budget (only 3% allocated)
Owner-alone decision making leading to potential founder burnout and bottlenecks
Adjacency teams are not adapting to the faster engineering cadence, creating process friction
Innovation bandwidth is heavily tied to immediate operational needs rather than strategic future planning
